place: Kalpeni Island Coral Debris and Scenic Lagoon
text: Kalpeni is an inhabited atoll in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. It has a distance of 287 km (178 mi) west of the city of Kochi.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
